name: Monster Girl Gamu
source:
Butch, a pompadour sporting delinquent, is transferred to a "delinquent school" in mysterious city. Much to his surprise, he finds the city filled with races of monsters. Despite the scare, Butch makes new friends with various monster girls. And so a new chapter in his life opens, one filled with the chance of love or the possibility of a painful death. 

[Taken from https://pastebin.com/skaKGQDd]
